implemented: Native adapter actions share a private per-runtime flock (one second maximum contention); no unlink-based unlocking.
Breeze and current window/process start are checked inside the common manager after acquiring the lock.
Task/desktop queues suspend during withdrawal, pending actions are discarded, read-only snapshots may be cancelled and in-flight mutations finish before ack.
RuntimeControl retries asynchronously without acknowledging or advancing revision while quiescing; existing publisher/hook deadlines remain unchanged.
Native tests exercise both task and desktop bridges through RuntimeControl/PanelRuntime and resume plasma afterwards.
virtualDesktopProviderFinding: VirtualDesktopInfo 6.7.5 exposes read-only properties, nonvirtual methods and a private static backend without a public provider factory. QML-only replacement cannot cover C++ sorting/per-screen filtering. Provider integration remains pending; no private-pointer or symbol interposition used.
limits: Flock only covers callers opting in to --native-serialized, not daily Quickshell/keybinding/other manager callers.
Withdrawal barrier covers registered bridges in this process, not all BWM processes or compositor operations.
Snapshot reads are not compositor-atomic. Final compositor identity guard remains address/PID, not Linux generation.
Forced process termination or existing execution timeout does not guarantee rollback of a partially applied common-manager mutation.
Controlled helper completion/ack tests and fake IPC; no new live Wayland/compositor session verification.
TaskManager desktops, full menu capabilities, other actions, daily activation authorities and visual acceptance remain pending.
ASan detect_leaks=0 does not certify leaks or uninstrumented external libraries.
No new external-widget/KNS gate run; earlier evidence remains scoped to its original version.
